title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
abstract: arXiv:2608.11216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World modeling is an unsettled field: architectures, training objectives, and state representations interact in complex ways, and no single recipe dominates across environments. This makes it an ideal testbed for AI coding agents acting as autonomous researchers--a setting in which the improvement direction is not specified in advance, unlike the engineering-to-spec tasks that dominate current agent benchmarks. We introduce AutoWorldModel-Bench, a closed-loop benchmark in which frontier coding agents autonomously improve a provided world-model starter under a fixed compute budget. The benchmark spans eight game environments under a unified structured-state representation--ground-truth entity state extracted from each game and consumed through a shared tensor format--which isolates dynamics modeling from perception and enables minutes-per-run iteration. Across 64 sessions, Codex-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 improve their starter on 63; in 91%

translated_title: 自动世界模型基准：面向自动化世界模型研究的以状态为中心的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11216v1 公告类型：新 摘要：世界建模是一个尚未定型的领域：架构、训练目标和状态表示以复杂的方式相互作用，没有单一的方案能在所有环境中占主导地位。这使其成为作为自主研究者的AI编码代理的理想测试平台——在这种设定中，改进方向并非预先指定，这与当前主导代理基准的按规格工程任务不同。我们引入了AutoWorldModel-Bench，一个闭环基准测试，其中前沿编码代理在固定的计算预算下自主改进提供的世界模型起始代码。该基准涵盖八个游戏环境，采用统一的结构化状态表示——从每个游戏中提取的真实实体状态，并通过共享的张量格式消费——这隔离了动力学建模与感知，并实现了每次运行仅需几分钟的迭代。在64次会话中，Codex-5.4和Claude Opus 4.6在63次中改进了它们的起始代码；在91%的情况下，它们实现了改进。
tldr: 该论文提出了AutoWorldModel-Bench，一个闭环基准测试，允许AI编码代理在固定计算预算下自主改进世界模型，在八个游戏环境中验证了前沿代理的改进能力，突出了其在自动化研究中的潜力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AutoWorldModel-Bench, a closed-loop benchmark enabling AI coding agents to autonomously improve world models under a fixed compute budget, validated across eight game environments, highlighting its potential for automated research.
